dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three prominent 'C' and 'O' shaped light-intensity regions along the dorsal ridge exhibit irregular, serrated perimeters with high-contrast transitions from dark-grey exteriors to light-grey interiors.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, dark, low-intensity pixel clusters located on the posterior-ventral flank and interspersed within the light dorsal macro-annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three primary dorsal light patches form an obtuse scalene triangle extending from the shoulder toward the posterior midsection.

other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'Y' shaped light-intensity pigmentation pattern located at the posterior insertion point of the visible pectoral flipper.
